t: This Act shall take effect upon the date of its enactment.

fable.w: This is a bare effective-date clause that only says when the Act takes effect. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision. There is no tempting contrary reading.
fable.s: This Act shall take effect upon the date of its enactment.
